Checks C/C++ header include guards against Firedancer style.

# Purpose
This script checks C and C++ header files under `./src` for include guards that follow Firedancer naming rules. It builds the expected guard name from each file path, skips generated protobuf headers with `.pb.h` in the name, and reports files that do not start with matching `#ifndef` and `#define` lines. The [`check_file`](<#check_file>) function reads each header, ignores leading blank and comment lines, and compares the guard text against the expected pattern. The [`main`](<#main>) function walks the source tree, applies the check to each `*.h` file, and prints read errors when file access fails.
